purpose: Course development validation; no sealed-test or cognitive accuracy claims

hypotheses.claim: Additional output and structure information yields stable clusters across seeds
hypotheses.falsifier: Low validation ARI between seeds or high medoid tie rates; stability is not correctness

hypotheses.claim: Depth-3 IF-THEN surrogate contains useful information beyond a constant cluster predictor
hypotheses.falsifier: Validation fidelity no better than training-majority-cluster baseline

hypotheses.claim: Clusters and rules capture a shared error mechanism
hypotheses.falsifier: Low pair precision/recall or low validation rule precision against independent adjudicated teacher labels
hypotheses.status: Not testable without real teacher labels

sealed_test: never scored or used for model choices
assignment: nearest training medoid under weighted Hamming, not nearest K-means centroid

human_evaluation.cognitive_support: learner explanation plus follow-up observation verified by coordinator

statistics: Descriptive per-problem/seed results; no independent-sample inference or superiority claim
